snippet.title: Duck Detective: The Ghost of Glamping Release Trailer
snippet.description:
You are the one and only Duck Detective, a depressed and recently divorced duck who must quack the case. Inspect evidence, make de-duck-tions, and solve this no-murder mystery!

Duck Detective: The Ghost of Glamping is out now for Steam, Nintendo Switch, Xbox Series X|S & One, PS5 & GOG

Get the game here: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2714620
https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/duck-detective-the-ghost-of-glamping-switch/
https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/duck-detective-the-ghost-of-glamping/9p30wgjmx413
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10013190
